name: The Almanac: Trades, Callings & Mastery
description: Identity-first trade progression for the modded world. Twenty-one domains, ranks from Novice to Grandmaster, earned by practice and never by grind: the day's work settles into your hands at rest. Requires The Almanac: Illuminated (0.0.14 or newer) and Smithing Plus (1.9.0 or newer). Part of The Almanac line.
